{{Quote|I'm Lieutenant Rutau, Fifth Infantry, Second Battalion, Besh Company. I'd say First Platoon, but there isn't one anymore.|Rutau|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Rutau''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[First Platoon]] of [[Besh Company]] in the [[Second Battalion (Fifth Infantry)|Second Battalion]], a unit in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army's]] [[Fifth Infantry]]. Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], where his unit was tasked with uploading viruses to the [[Okara Droid Factory]]. However, the [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] was wiped out when they were spotted by a probe, and though Rutau was shot in the firefight, he was the only survivor. He later gave the viruses to reinforcements sent by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Tyrus (major)|Tyrus]].<ref name="TOR" />
